_about: Every competitor fact for the /next/ pricing and feature comparison, each with the page it was read from and the date. Gathered by researcher.agenticcells-ai@AgentiCCells.dinis on 2026-11-19 for conductor.agenticcells-ai@AgentiCCells.dinis.
_read_by: researcher.agenticcells-ai@AgentiCCells.dinis, 2026-11-19, with curl and Chromium (Playwright, locale en-GB). Our network address was in the United States, so every competitor showed US dollar prices; no UK (GBP) prices could be read.
_rules: Competitor prices use ISO currency codes (USD), never symbols. basis is 'their own page', 'calculated from their published price' (our arithmetic from their figure, before tax, assuming the price does not change) or 'not stated on their pages'. Lock-in summaries are our reading of their terms and quote the line they rest on. Promotions on the day are recorded separately and not used in the sums. Our own prices come from data/next/offer.json and use £ with the words launch price.
